title: Total count in acetylene
hints: Each extra bond order on the triple bond is pi.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: The two C–H bonds and one C–C connection give three sigma bonds. The triple bond supplies two pi bonds.
statement:
How many sigma and pi bonds are in $\ce{HC#CH}$?

[_]{a}

explanations: All connections and both extra bonding interactions are included.
A triple bond is not three sigma bonds.
Two C–H sigma bonds were omitted.
The C–C triple bond contains one sigma connection.
